run.answer: The data date moved from 23 December 2026 to 20 January 2027, and 5,855 of the 10,010 activities changed: 349 progressed, 20 were added, 10 were removed, 55 had duration changes, 81 had logic changes and 10 had constraint changes. Project completion (#MS-COMPLETE) and Phase 7 (#MS-P07) both slipped +65 days to 22 June 2029, while #MS-P03, #MS-P05, #MS-P04 and #MS-P06 slipped between +1 and +5 days. #MS-P01 came in -5 days and #MS-P02 came in -24 days, and the critical path changed a lot: 97 activities joined it and 206 left it.
